com.launchdarkly.sdk.server.ai

Interface LDAIClient

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    LDAIClientImpl

    public interface LDAIClient
    The LaunchDarkly Server-Side AI client, for retrieving AI Configs.

    An LDAIClient wraps an initialized server-side LDClient. Each retrieval method evaluates the AI Config flag for the given key and context, validates that the variation's mode matches the requested kind, interpolates any prompt messages or instructions with the supplied variables (and the evaluation context, exposed to templates as ldctx), and returns a strongly-typed config.

    When the flag is absent, cannot be evaluated, or its mode does not match the requested kind, the caller-supplied default is returned as the corresponding config type (a warning is logged on a mode mismatch); a config is never returned in a state that would force the caller into a NullPointerException.

    Implementations are thread-safe.

      • agentConfigs

        java.util.Map<java.lang.String,AIAgentConfig> agentConfigs(java.util.List<AIAgentConfigRequest> agentConfigs,
                                                           com.launchdarkly.sdk.LDContext context)
        Retrieves multiple agent AI Configs in a single call.

        Each request carries its own key, default, and interpolation variables. The returned map is keyed by agent key and preserves the order of the requests.

        Parameters:
        agentConfigs - the agent requests to retrieve
        context - the context to evaluate the configurations in
        Returns:
        a map of agent key to its retrieved AIAgentConfig, never null

      • createTracker

        LDAIConfigTracker createTracker(java.lang.String resumptionToken,
                                com.launchdarkly.sdk.LDContext context)
        Reconstructs a tracker from a resumption token, preserving the original run's identity.

        Use this when a multi-turn or streaming AI interaction spans multiple requests. The caller stores the resumption token from a previous tracker (via LDAIConfigTracker.getResumptionToken()) and passes it back here to continue tracking against the same run.

        Security note: resumption tokens embed flag-evaluation details such as the variation key and config version. Keep tokens server-side and do not round-trip them through untrusted clients where they could leak flag-targeting information.

        Parameters:
        resumptionToken - the token returned by a previous tracker; must not be null
        context - the evaluation context for the new request; must not be null
        Returns:
        a tracker with the decoded run identity, never null
        Throws:
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if the token is malformed

      • agentGraph

        AgentGraphDefinition agentGraph(java.lang.String graphKey,
                                com.launchdarkly.sdk.LDContext context,
                                java.util.Map<java.lang.String,java.lang.Object> variables)
        Fetches and validates an agent graph definition identified by graphKey.

        Evaluates the graph flag, fetches all referenced node configs, and validates the graph structure. If validation fails (disabled flag, empty root, unreachable nodes, or any non-enabled child config) the returned definition has AgentGraphDefinition.isEnabled() == false and an empty node map.

        Also emits a $ld:ai:usage:agent-graph usage event.

        Parameters:
        graphKey - the flag key identifying the agent graph
        context - the evaluation context
        variables - Mustache template variables applied to each node's instructions
        Returns:
        the resolved graph definition; never null

        AIGraphTracker createGraphTracker(java.lang.String resumptionToken,
                                  com.launchdarkly.sdk.LDContext context)
        Reconstructs an AIGraphTracker from a resumption token.

        Use this to continue tracking a graph run across requests by passing the token produced by AIGraphTracker.getResumptionToken().

        Parameters:
        resumptionToken - the token produced by a prior AIGraphTracker
        context - the evaluation context
        Returns:
        a reconstructed tracker with the original run identity
        Throws:
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if the token is malformed
